column1: # plumOS V90S libretro core build recipes.
#   A: V90S bring-up core set. Build only these with `PLUMOS_CORE_FILTER=v90s`.
# The normal `scripts/docker-build.sh cores` target builds all A/B recipes.
# V90S runs an aarch64 userspace, so these recipes intentionally use generic
# `platform=unix` or upstream-supported native targets instead of MMF/A30's
